description: This file defines internal logging interfaces and a logger implementation for gRPC, including severity levels, JSON formatting, and logger configuration.

classes.name: loggerT
classes.description: Default logger implementation handling severity levels, JSON formatting, and output.

methods.name: output
methods.description: Outputs log message with severity, formatted as JSON or plain text.

methods.name: printf
methods.description: Formats and outputs a log message.

methods.name: print
methods.description: Outputs a log message with sprint formatting.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Outputs a log message with sprintln formatting.

methods.name: Infoln
methods.description: Logs an info message with newline.

methods.name: Warningln
methods.description: Logs a warning message with newline.

methods.name: Errorln
methods.description: Logs an error message with newline.

methods.name: Fatal
methods.description: Logs a fatal error and exits.

methods.name: Fatalln
methods.description: Logs a fatal error with newline and exits.

methods.name: Fatalf
methods.description: Logs a formatted fatal error and exits.

methods.name: V
methods.description: Checks if verbosity level l is enabled.
